<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-raw-or-organic-honey-free-from-heavy-metals" data-anchor="is-raw-or-organic-honey-free-from-heavy-metals" data-question="Is raw or organic honey free from heavy metals?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is raw or organic honey free from heavy metals?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

No source in the HMI ledger compares organic-certified and conventional honey for metals, so there is no evidence either way. Raw honey from beekeepers is not automatically lower: five Balkan samples, four from beekeepers and one from a shop, all had lead between 33 and 55 µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/bektashi2021-honey-metals-sugars-balkans|9]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Limani Bektashi N, Abazi D, Popovska O, Latifi A, Reka AA · 2021</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/bektashi2021-honey-metals-sugars-balkans">Characterization of honey: determination of metal and sugar content</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Agricultural, Food and Environmental Sciences</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/bektashi2021-honey-metals-sugars-balkans">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="which-types-of-honey-have-the-lowest-levels" data-anchor="which-types-of-honey-have-the-lowest-levels" data-question="Which types of honey have the lowest levels?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Which types of honey have the lowest levels?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Within one Italian study, chestnut honey had the lowest lead and wildflower the highest, but no study shows a floral type that is reliably lower everywhere.<sup class="cite">[[sources/naccari2025-honey-toxic-metals-microelements|17]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Naccari C, Ferrantelli V, Cammilleri G, Barbaccia G, Riolo P, Ferrante MC, Procopio A, Palma E · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/naccari2025-honey-toxic-metals-microelements">Study of Toxic Metals and Microelements in Honey as a Tool to Support Beekeeping Production and Consumer Safety</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2025, 14, 1986</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/naccari2025-honey-toxic-metals-microelements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Honeydew honey tends to carry more aluminium.<sup class="cite">[[sources/tomczyk2020-polish-honey-metal-transfer|5]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Tomczyk M, Zagula G, Puchalski C, Dzugan M · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/tomczyk2020-polish-honey-metal-transfer">Transfer of some toxic metals from soil to honey depending on bee habitat conditions</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Acta Universitatis Cibiniensis Series E: Food Technology</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/tomczyk2020-polish-honey-metal-transfer">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="which-countries-or-regions-produce-honey-with-the-lowest-lead" data-anchor="which-countries-or-regions-produce-honey-with-the-lowest-lead" data-question="Which countries or regions produce honey with the lowest lead?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Which countries or regions produce honey with the lowest lead?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Monitored retail honey in the US, Europe and Australia shows the lowest lead in the evidence, with US composites below 4 µg/kg and most European results below detection.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fsanz2019-25th-australian-total-diet-study|7]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Food Standards Australia New Zealand · 2019</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fsanz2019-25th-australian-total-diet-study">25th Australian Total Diet Study</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Standards Australia New Zealand</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fsanz2019-25th-australian-total-diet-study">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Surveys from Iran, Morocco and Libya report higher values, but they used different methods and sampling, so they cannot rank countries.<sup class="cite">[[sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Aghamirlou HM, Khadem M, Rahmani A, Sadeghian M, Mahvi AH, Akbarzadeh A, Nazmara S · 2015</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals">Heavy metals determination in honey samples using inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Health Science &amp; Engineering</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/abeslami2025-moroccan-honey-minerals|10]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Abeslami A, El Farissi H, Cacciola F, El Bachiri A, Sindic M, Fauconnier ML, Bruneau E, Talhaoui A · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/abeslami2025-moroccan-honey-minerals">Unveiling the Mineral and Sugar Richness of Moroccan Honeys: A Study of Botanical Origins and Quality Indicators</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/abeslami2025-moroccan-honey-minerals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/aburas2023-libyan-honey-lead-cadmium|18]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Aburas NM, Amaizah NR, Hadidan ME · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/aburas2023-libyan-honey-lead-cadmium">Pollution assessment by estimation of Lead and Cadmium concentrations and some physical properties in a number of types of Libyan Honey</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Bani Waleed University Journal of Humanities and Applied Sciences</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/aburas2023-libyan-honey-lead-cadmium">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="do-foods-made-with-honey-also-contain-heavy-metals" data-anchor="do-foods-made-with-honey-also-contain-heavy-metals" data-question="Do foods made with honey also contain heavy metals?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Do foods made with honey also contain heavy metals?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

No study in the ledger measured both a honey and the food made with it. Honey-sweetened cereal bars and infant cereals have been tested, but their lead cannot be attributed to the honey.<sup class="cite">[[sources/hidalgo2015-gluten-free-cereal-bars-argentina|19]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Hidalgo MJ, Villafane RN, Sgroppo SC, Marchevsky EJ, Pellerano RG · 2015</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/hidalgo2015-gluten-free-cereal-bars-argentina">Toxic Trace Element Contents in Gluten-free Cereal Bars Marketed in Argentina</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">International Journal of Celiac Disease 3(1):12-16</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/hidalgo2015-gluten-free-cereal-bars-argentina">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/depa2019-baby-food-lead-cadmium|20]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Depa Keshava R. · 2019</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/depa2019-baby-food-lead-cadmium">Heavy Metals in Baby Foods and Cereal Products</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Turkish Journal of Computer and Mathematics Education</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/depa2019-baby-food-lead-cadmium">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-do-the-levels-in-honey-mean-for-health" data-anchor="what-do-the-levels-in-honey-mean-for-health" data-question="What do the levels in honey mean for health?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What do the levels in honey mean for health?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Because honey is eaten in small amounts, it contributes little lead to most diets: in Australia it was a minor source for all ages except children aged 2–5, where it supplied 6%.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fsanz2019-25th-australian-total-diet-study|7]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Food Standards Australia New Zealand · 2019</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fsanz2019-25th-australian-total-diet-study">25th Australian Total Diet Study</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Food Standards Australia New Zealand</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fsanz2019-25th-australian-total-diet-study">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> A widely cited US claim that honey exceeds tolerable intakes rests on a unit error in that paper.<sup class="cite">[[sources/wise2025-elevated-metals-us-honeys|13]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Wise JP Jr, Wise RM, Hoffert A, Wise JTF, Specht AJ · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/wise2025-elevated-metals-us-honeys">Elevated Metal Levels in U.S. Honeys: Is There a Concern for Human Health?</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Biological Trace Element Research</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/wise2025-elevated-metals-us-honeys">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="are-there-legal-limits-for-heavy-metals-in-honey" data-anchor="are-there-legal-limits-for-heavy-metals-in-honey" data-question="Are there legal limits for heavy metals in honey?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Are there legal limits for heavy metals in honey?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Yes, mostly for lead: the EU allows 0.10 mg/kg, Hong Kong 0.1 mg/kg, MERCOSUR 0.30 mg/kg and China 0.5 mg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 of 25 April 2023 on maximum levels for certain contaminants in food and repealing Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/hongkong2025-cap-132v-metallic-contamination|21]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Hong Kong e-Legislation · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/hongkong2025-cap-132v-metallic-contamination">Hong Kong Cap. 132V Food Adulteration (Metallic Contamination) Regulations, consolidated 5 September 2025</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Hong Kong e-Legislation Cap. 132V</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/hongkong2025-cap-132v-metallic-contamination">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants|26]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">MERCOSUR Grupo Mercado Comun · 2011</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants">MERCOSUR/GMC/RES. No. 12/11: Reglamento Tecnico MERCOSUR sobre Limites Maximos de Contaminantes Inorganicos en Alimentos</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">MERCOSUR/GMC/RES. No. 12/11</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/usda-fas2023-china-gb-2762-2022-translation|27]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, FAS China Staff (Beijing) · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/usda-fas2023-china-gb-2762-2022-translation">China Releases the Standard for Maximum Levels of Contaminants in Foods (USDA FAS GAIN Report CH2023-0040, unofficial translation of GB 2762-2022)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, Global Agricultural Information Network (GAIN), Report Number CH2023-0040</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/usda-fas2023-china-gb-2762-2022-translation">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> MERCOSUR also sets cadmium (0.10) and total arsenic (0.30 mg/kg) limits for honey.<sup class="cite">[[sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants|26]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">MERCOSUR Grupo Mercado Comun · 2011</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants">MERCOSUR/GMC/RES. No. 12/11: Reglamento Tecnico MERCOSUR sobre Limites Maximos de Contaminantes Inorganicos en Alimentos</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">MERCOSUR/GMC/RES. No. 12/11</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/mercosur2011-gmc-res-12-inorganic-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="can-processing-or-filtering-remove-heavy-metals-from-honey" data-anchor="can-processing-or-filtering-remove-heavy-metals-from-honey" data-question="Can processing or filtering remove heavy metals from honey?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Can processing or filtering remove heavy metals from honey?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

No study in the ledger measured metal removal by filtering or processing honey. The supported advice is preventive: keep honey out of soldered, uncoated or galvanised metal containers.<sup class="cite">[[sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Aghamirlou HM, Khadem M, Rahmani A, Sadeghian M, Mahvi AH, Akbarzadeh A, Nazmara S · 2015</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals">Heavy metals determination in honey samples using inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Health Science &amp; Engineering</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/manouchehri2021-honey-heavy-metals-review|6]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Manouchehri A, Pirhadi M, Shokri S, Khaniki GJ, Shamaei S, Miranzadeh MH · 2021</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/manouchehri2021-honey-heavy-metals-review">The Possible Effects of Heavy Metals in Honey as Toxic and Carcinogenic Substances on Human Health: A Systematic Review</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Arı Dergisi / Uludag Bee Journal</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/manouchehri2021-honey-heavy-metals-review">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-honeydew-honey-different-from-blossom-honey" data-anchor="is-honeydew-honey-different-from-blossom-honey" data-question="Is honeydew honey different from blossom honey?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is honeydew honey different from blossom honey?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Yes for aluminium: Polish honeydew honey carried far more aluminium than blossom honeys from the same apiaries.<sup class="cite">[[sources/tomczyk2020-polish-honey-metal-transfer|5]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Tomczyk M, Zagula G, Puchalski C, Dzugan M · 2020</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/tomczyk2020-polish-honey-metal-transfer">Transfer of some toxic metals from soil to honey depending on bee habitat conditions</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Acta Universitatis Cibiniensis Series E: Food Technology</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/tomczyk2020-polish-honey-metal-transfer">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> For lead it was neither lowest nor highest in the Calabrian study.<sup class="cite">[[sources/naccari2025-honey-toxic-metals-microelements|17]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Naccari C, Ferrantelli V, Cammilleri G, Barbaccia G, Riolo P, Ferrante MC, Procopio A, Palma E · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/naccari2025-honey-toxic-metals-microelements">Study of Toxic Metals and Microelements in Honey as a Tool to Support Beekeeping Production and Consumer Safety</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2025, 14, 1986</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/naccari2025-honey-toxic-metals-microelements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="should-honey-be-stored-in-metal-containers" data-anchor="should-honey-be-stored-in-metal-containers" data-question="Should honey be stored in metal containers?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Should honey be stored in metal containers?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Survey authors and reviews advise against soldered, uncoated or galvanised metal, because acidic honey can corrode it and pick up lead, tin or zinc.<sup class="cite">[[sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Aghamirlou HM, Khadem M, Rahmani A, Sadeghian M, Mahvi AH, Akbarzadeh A, Nazmara S · 2015</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals">Heavy metals determination in honey samples using inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Journal of Environmental Health Science &amp; Engineering</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/aghamirlou2015-iranian-honey-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/manouchehri2021-honey-heavy-metals-review|6]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Manouchehri A, Pirhadi M, Shokri S, Khaniki GJ, Shamaei S, Miranzadeh MH · 2021</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/manouchehri2021-honey-heavy-metals-review">The Possible Effects of Heavy Metals in Honey as Toxic and Carcinogenic Substances on Human Health: A Systematic Review</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Arı Dergisi / Uludag Bee Journal</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/manouchehri2021-honey-heavy-metals-review">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/teferi2026-honey-ethiopia-kellem-wollega|14]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Teferi AN, Dibabe YB, Debalke AG, Beyene TW, Feng W, Ho C · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/teferi2026-honey-ethiopia-kellem-wollega">Assessment of Heavy Metal Contamination and Associated Health Risks in Honey from Kellem Wollega Zone, Ethiopia</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Toxics</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/teferi2026-honey-ethiopia-kellem-wollega">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> This is guidance; no source measured the effect.

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="how-can-i-tell-whether-a-honey-lead-test-is-good-enough" data-anchor="how-can-i-tell-whether-a-honey-lead-test-is-good-enough" data-question="How can I tell whether a honey lead test is good enough?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>How can I tell whether a honey lead test is good enough?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Check that the laboratory’s quantification limit is far below 100 µg/kg; FDA reported down to 4 µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 of 25 April 2023 on maximum levels for certain contaminants in food and repealing Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> A published low-cost lead sensor could only see about 378 µg/kg in honey, too high to check the EU limit.<sup class="cite">[[sources/zhang2024-mip-pb-honey-cyprus|16]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Karagozlu M, Asir S, Abu Shama N, Gokturk I, Yilmaz F, Turkmen D, Denizli A, Ozgoren M · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/zhang2024-mip-pb-honey-cyprus">Development of Molecularly Imprinted Magnetic Amino Acid-Based Nanoparticles for Voltammetric Analysis of Lead Ions in Honey</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Polymers 2024, 16, 1782</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/zhang2024-mip-pb-honey-cyprus">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="has-lead-in-honey-been-falling" data-anchor="has-lead-in-honey-been-falling" data-question="Has lead in honey been falling?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Has lead in honey been falling?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

In European GEMS/Food submissions, the share of results definitely above 100 µg/kg fell from 6.7% in 2003–2007 to 1.3% in 2013–2019.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> These are national monitoring submissions, not a fixed panel of producers.

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="does-honey-contain-mercury-or-arsenic" data-anchor="does-honey-contain-mercury-or-arsenic" data-question="Does honey contain mercury or arsenic?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Does honey contain mercury or arsenic?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Usually very little: about four in five European mercury results were below detection, and US composites were below 1 µg/kg mercury and 3 µg/kg arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> A US paper reporting mercury in the mg/kg range used an unverified method and is not used here.<sup class="cite">[[sources/wise2025-elevated-metals-us-honeys|13]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Wise JP Jr, Wise RM, Hoffert A, Wise JTF, Specht AJ · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/wise2025-elevated-metals-us-honeys">Elevated Metal Levels in U.S. Honeys: Is There a Concern for Human Health?</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Biological Trace Element Research</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/wise2025-elevated-metals-us-honeys">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>
